meta.name: zig-best-practices
meta.description: Use when reading or writing Zig files (.zig, build.zig, build.zig.zon).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出规范易维护的 Zig 代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在编写或阅读 Zig 代码,希望代码更规范。
copy.tagline_en: Write well-structured Zig code using recommended patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write or read Zig code and care about code quality.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在读或写 Zig 文件时,会按该技能给出 Zig 惯用写法:用带标签联合、显式错误集、不同 ID 类型等,并在分配内存时显式传分配器、用 defer/errdefer 清理,必要时使用 zigdoc/ziglint 辅助。
howto.when: 当用户读取或编写以 .zig、build.zig、build.zig.zon 结尾的 Zig 文件时触发。

say.text: 看看这段 Zig 内存管理有没有泄漏
say.note: Claude 会按技能检查分配器、defer 等写法。

say.text: 把这两个状态表示改成带标签联合 union(enum)
say.note: Claude 会给出互斥状态的惯用写法。

say.text: 用 ziglint 检查当前目录并忽略 Z001 规则

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude applies this skill when reading or writing Zig files: it uses tagged unions, explicit error sets, distinct domain-ID types, comptime validation, explicit allocator passing, defer/errdefer cleanup, and zigdoc/ziglint tooling where relevant.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user reads or writes Zig files whose names end in .zig, build.zig, or build.zig.zon.

say_en.text: Review this Zig code for memory leaks.
say_en.note: It checks allocators and defer/errdefer usage.

say_en.text: Re-model these two states as a tagged union(enum).
say_en.note: It applies the skill's union pattern.

say_en.text: Run ziglint on this directory and ignore Z001.
